notes.text: The supplied heading has abbreviated R' Elazar bar Malai. The stored Davidson Shabbat139a instead has full Rabbi Eliezer ben Malai reporting Resh Lakish. Keep Elazar/Eliezer and bar/ben distinct; the different named occurrence does not automatically expand the heading title. The body's Resh Lakish reading is supported by that exact scalar.
